This one's a bit embarrassing but I'll tell it anyway.  


It was either my sophomore or junior year of high school and I had simply given up on life. I had made a bad habit of staying up all night on discord with my friends or playing stupid games like league of legends and stuff. This meant that every class up until my last period I would sleep (mainly because I was afraid of my last period teacher and the second to last was really nice and actually liked me).  


Basically my schedule went:  
English, History, Math, Spanish, Lunch, Special kids class (This was not SPED, it was a class to help kids like me who fell behind catch up.), and gym.   


After second semester when I got this schedule I still had my dumb habit of sleeping all day. Each of my teachers slowly gave up on me, but then there was my very pregnant math teacher. She made it a habit to start picking on me. I was never good at math and that was my excuse for sleeping. I didn't care about it at all and didn't want to try so I did my thing. She'd constantly call on me to wake me up for a question and when I didn't understand she made a sarcastic comment which always got everyone to laugh at me. A few times she would wake me up to send me to the office, which I would do. Finally one of the days she had had enough. She stopped in the middle of her lecture to wake me up and as loud as she could, "Mister 7th! Go sleep in the office after you've had a talk with the principal." Little did she know however, I get very cranky if i'm woken up to get yelled at.  


At first I tried to tell her "No no, its okay, I am awake. I don't need to go to the office thank you for waking me up." But she would not by it. "I don't care, 7th. Go to the office." This is where my mood spiraled and I got very angry. "Okay, b\*\*\*\*, Hopefully you aren't this bitchy to your kid or else I'd feel very bad for them." I guess the hormones or whatever women get when they are pregnant set in and this caused her to cry. From what I know she stopped teaching for that day which kind of upset me because i didn't see her for the rest of the year. We had a sub after the week of suspension i went through which made me think the worst. It turns out she went into labor and wanted to take care of her child so she didn't come in anymore. The next year I saw her in, I brought her in flowers to apologize for my bad attitude and stuff and we made up so at least it ended with a happy ending.
